title: Editing the resume with the original alongside
description: A suggestion is compared with the previous text and accepted piece by piece.

blocks.text: A brief wording can accidentally remove an important specialization or change the level of responsibility. Smoothness hides a loss like that.

quote.text: The ai changes everything to something. Completely different

blocks.text: Show the changes and keep the original version. Mark separately any added facts the owner hasn’t confirmed yet.
The author should be able to undo an accepted edit later. Rewriting the whole document automatically makes it hard to tell which words they are answerable for.
